description: Not a lever of the fused stack: the scheduler-side work of docs/tp4-sched-1.md on the production shape (many returning turns of ~3k tokens beside a few cold prefills): complete spills of the host KV tier (QWEN_PREFIX_HOST_TIER_SPILL_MODE=complete), the lean admission (QWEN_FAST_ADMISSION_LEAN=1), the returning-turn pacing (QWEN_FAST_LEVERN_OWED_CAP_MS / _SHORT_SHARE / _SHORT_WAIT_S) and the ported few-decoder policy (QWEN_FAST_LEVERN_ADAPTIVE). Every flag is gate only and default off; the six gate-only twins of the approved ship-4 profile are generated by make_sched_profiles.py (-sch-lean, -sch-spill, -sch-pace, -sch-adaptive, -sch-all, -sch-all-audit) and the window pack is references/fusion-jobs/SCH (make_sched_jobs.py).
notes: No new module is served: the levers are edits of served modules that are already in the overlay and the P8 copy lists (levern_policy, levern_scheduler, serving_prefill_admission, serving_request_factory, serving_runtime, serving_c2_contract, qwen_prefix_registry, qwen_prefix_scheduler_patch, prefix_markers). sched_sim.py, sched_report.py, make_sched_profiles.py and make_sched_jobs.py are host-side tools. The twins are placed by make_sched_profiles.py (right after the ship-4 twins, and tp4/np1-fastlane's when merged), not by make_fusion_profiles.py: they sit outside its namespace on purpose.
